fetch_lfw_people: fetch the Labeled Faces in the Wild people dataset for face identification classification with custom resize and color options
fetch_lfw_pairs: fetch the Labeled Faces in the Wild pairs dataset for face verification with train, test, or 10_folds subsets
_check_fetch_lfw: check and download missing LFW data archives and metadata files to the specified data home directory
_fetch_lfw_people: load LFW people face images from disk with optional slicing, resizing, color channels, and minimum faces per person filtering
_fetch_lfw_pairs: load LFW face pair images from an index file with optional slicing, resizing, and color channel options
